name: Grade 8 IIIT Practice: November Week 10 - Game Build
description: Practice words for Grade 8 third-trimester app, Python, and Micro:bit work.

words.definition: The basic starting structure of a game.
words.example: The game shell included the start screen and score variable.
The background showed the scene behind the player sprite.
Motion made the sprite move across the stage.

words.definition: The repeated actions that keep a game running.
words.example: The game loop checked controls and obstacles again and again.

words.definition: A number that tracks points or progress.
words.example: The score increased when the player collected an item.

words.definition: Something that blocks or challenges the player.
words.example: The obstacle made the player lose a point.

words.definition: A way the player makes something happen.
words.example: Keyboard control moved the sprite left and right.
